evidence: The qSOFA uses 3 variables to predict death and prolonged ICU stay in patients with known or suspected sepsis: a Glasgow Coma Score < 15, a respiratory rate ≥ 22 breaths/min and a systolic blood pressure ≤ 100 mmHg. When any two of these variables are present simultaneously the patient is considered to be qSOFA positive.
note: Population: patients with known or suspected sepsis. Recommendation advises against qSOFA as a single screening tool.
